definitions.gloss: to suffer; to sustain; to experience (something negative)
definitions.explanation: To undergo or receive something unpleasant — typically defeat, a loss, or a setback. Used in formal and written contexts; the most common collocates are {敗北|はいぼく} (defeat) and {惨敗|ざんぱい} (crushing defeat).

examples.japanese: ⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}した。
⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}して⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧。
examples.english: The team ended the season having suffered a crushing defeat.

examples.japanese: {強豪校|きょうごうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{完封負|かんぷうま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}し、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Having suffered a shutout loss to a powerhouse school, the players were left speechless.

notes:
Primarily used in the fixed phrase ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}する to mean "to suffer ~". Mostly seen in sports reporting, news, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}する: to suffer a defeat
- ⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}する: to suffer a crushing defeat
- {完封負|かんぷうま}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}する: to suffer a shutout loss
- ⟦{逆転負|ぎゃくてんま}け→逆転負け：16452_gyakutenmake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{喫|きっ}する: to suffer a come-from-behind loss

The kanji {喫|きっ} also appears in ⟦{喫茶|きっさ}→喫茶：28984_kissa⟧ (coffee shop) and ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧ (smoking), where it carries the sense of "taking in" or "consuming".

forms.negative: {喫|きっ}していませんでした
